name: SemaevTower
why_it_matters: Defines the general Semaev summation polynomial S_m over any commutative ring by the resultant recursion S_{m} = Res_T(S_{m-1}(..., T), S3(x_{m-2}, x_{m-1}, T)) with fixed Sylvester sizes (2^(m-3), 2), proves agreement with S3 and with the existing S4, the degree upper bound 2^(m-2) in the last variable, and the forward direction (a chain of S3 witnesses forces S_m = 0) at every level. The repository previously had only the one-step tool resultant_eq_zero_of_common_root and the secp256k1-specific projective frozen family. The column-weight determinant bound and the 2^(s+1) slice bound have close precedents in FrozenRecursiveProjectiveSemaev.lean (natDegree_det_le_sum_row; previousSliceAtOver_frozenC_natDegree_le for the secp256k1 frozen family).
